starting_cash_flow.note: FCF-minus-SBC is a conservative economic proxy, not a GAAP metric. The model does not subtract dilution again after treating SBC as an economic cost.

reverse_dcf.interpretation: The reference price does not require continuation of current 50%+ revenue growth. It requires low-double-digit owner-cash growth if the starting cash-flow base is normalized and durable.

key_sensitivities: Whether 2026 operating and FCF margins are structural or peak
Independent durability of advertiser ROAS and retention
valuation_conclusion: PASS for the unrealistic-bull-case veto, but not a margin-of-safety buy signal. Base value is near the reference price and Bear downside is material.
